## Vote

::: {.vote-q}
Grandma says: "We have **always** done it this way." Which way of knowing is this?
:::

::: {.vote-grid}
::: {.vote-opt}
**1** Authority 權威
:::
::: {.vote-opt}
**2** Tradition 傳統與前例
:::
::: {.vote-opt}
**3** Common sense 一般常識
:::
::: {.vote-opt}
**4** Intuition 個人直覺
:::
:::

::: {.vote-steps}
Vote with your fingers → talk with your partner (30 seconds) → vote again
:::

::: {.fragment .vote-ans}
Answer: 2 Tradition. "Always done it this way" does not mean "it works."
:::

**Pair talk:** Many of our families use Chinese medicine. How can a social worker respect a family's culture **and** share this evidence?

::: {.notes}
Frame: research checked specific herbs; it is not "Chinese medicine is wrong." The Ministry of Health and Welfare says legal Chinese medicine products on the market today test negative for aristolochic acid (GMP factories). Lesson: ask, check the source, see a licensed doctor.
:::

::: {.vote-q}

::: {.vote-opt}

## Vote

::: {.vote-q}
You talk with Grandpa for one hour about his life, then look for themes in his words. This is...
:::

::: {.vote-grid}
::: {.vote-opt}
**1** Quantitative 量化
:::
::: {.vote-opt}
**2** Qualitative 質性
:::
::: {.vote-opt}
**3** Deductive 演繹法
:::
::: {.vote-opt}
**4** An experiment 實驗
:::
:::

::: {.vote-steps}
Vote with your fingers → talk with your partner (30 seconds) → vote again
:::

::: {.fragment .vote-ans}
Answer: 2 Qualitative. Words, a natural setting, and themes that come from the data (inductive).
:::

## {.big-svg}

![](imgs/11_15b_ai_math.svg){fig-align="center"}

::: {.notes}
Bastani et al. (2025), PNAS: field experiment, nearly 1,000 high school math students in Turkey, randomly given no AI, plain GPT-4 ("GPT Base") or a hint-giving tutor ("GPT Tutor") during practice. Practice scores rose 48% / 127%; when AI was removed for the exam, GPT Base students scored 17% lower than students who never had AI; the tutor group showed no drop. Ask first: "Guess what happened on the exam?"
:::

## {.effect-picker}

```{=html}
<style>
.reveal .effect-picker .ep-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 1fr); gap: 8px; margin-top: 40px; }
.reveal .effect-picker .ep-box { min-width: 0; height: 430px; border: 4px solid #2c5f6f; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; text-align: center;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 6px 4px; transition: .3s; }
.reveal .effect-picker .ep-box .n { font-size: 1.4em; font-weight: 700; color: #2c5f6f; }
.reveal .effect-picker .ep-box .en { font-size: .42em; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; margin: 10px 0 6px; }
.reveal .effect-picker .ep-box .zh { font-size: .4em; color: #6b7a8c; }
.reveal .effect-picker .ep-box .g { font-size: .6em; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-top: 18px; min-height: 1.3em; }
.reveal .effect-picker .ep-box.taken { background: #2c5f6f; }
.reveal .effect-picker .ep-box.taken .n, .reveal .effect-picker .ep-box.taken .en, .reveal .effect-picker .ep-box.taken .zh { color: #fff; }
.reveal .effect-picker .ep-box.new { background: #d98e3a; border-color: #d98e3a; transform: scale(1.06); }
.reveal .effect-picker .ep-btns { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 30px; margin-top: 40px; }
.reveal .effect-picker .ep-btns button { font-size: .8em; padding: 10px 50px; border-radius: 40px; border: 0; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; }
</style>
<div class="ep-row" id="epRow"></div>
<div class="ep-btns">
  <button id="epPick" style="background:#d98e3a;color:#fff">Pick 抽</button>
  <button id="epReset" style="background:#e8eef0;color:#2c5f6f">Reset 重來</button>
</div>
<script>
(() => {
  const E = [['Hawthorne effect', '霍桑效應'], ['Social desirability bias', '社會期許偏誤'], ['Authority bias', '權威偏誤'],
    ['Confirmation bias', '確認偏誤'], ['Placebo effect', '安慰劑效應'], ['Survivorship bias', '倖存者偏誤'],
    ['Selection bias', '選擇偏誤'], ['Correlation ≠ causation', '相關不等於因果']];
  const row = document.getElementById('epRow');
  row.innerHTML = E.map((e, i) => `<div class="ep-box"><div class="n">${i + 1}</div><div class="en">${e[0]}</div><div class="zh">${e[1]}</div><div class="g"></div></div>`).join('');
  const boxes = [...row.children];
  let group = 0;
  document.getElementById('epPick').onclick = () => {
    const free = boxes.filter(b => !b.classList.contains('taken'));
    if (!free.length) return;
    boxes.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('new'));
    const b = free[Math.floor(Math.random() * free.length)];
    b.classList.add('taken', 'new');
    b.querySelector('.g').textContent = `第 ${++group} 組`;
  };
  document.getElementById('epReset').onclick = () => {
    group = 0;
    boxes.forEach(b => { b.classList.remove('taken', 'new'); b.querySelector('.g').textContent = ''; });
  };
})();
</script>
```

## Game: The Family Next Door 隔壁那一家

::: {.act-card}
1. **Pairs, one phone.** One taps, one reads aloud. Swap every time a new place opens.
2. Ah-Zhe wants to help the family next door. First he **guesses**. Watch what happens.
3. Find the right books in the library and pass the **BSW** and **MSW** exams. **Every card must be right.** Decide each answer together.
4. Come home as a social worker. You have **30 days** to save the empty lot with evidence.
:::

![](imgs/11_game_qr.png){fig-align="center" width="22%"}

::: {.frame}
ncnusw.github.io/introsw → The Family Next Door. New phone? Codes: LIBRARY · MASTER · HOMECOMING
:::

```{r}
countdown(minutes = 40, seconds = 0)
```
